bynk.given.parameter_name_conflict the capability parameter `Kv` has the name of a capability this commons selects
bynk.given.parameter_name_conflict the capability parameter `Logger` has the name of a capability this commons selects
bynk.given.parameter_name_conflict the capability parameter `S` has the name of another capability parameter of this function
bynk.given.parameter_name_conflict the capability parameter `T` has the name of a type parameter of this function
